intro: Websites start at the prices below, and I agree the scope and final price with you before work begins. Optional care plans have fixed monthly prices. Other projects are quoted individually.

principles: Website development is a one-time project fee.
Clients retain their websites after canceling maintenance.
Ownership of agreed custom deliverables transfers after full payment, subject to third-party licenses.
Domain, hosting, software subscriptions and AI usage costs are disclosed before launch.
Additional work requires client approval before billing.
Each project has a clearly defined scope.

faq.q: Do I have to purchase maintenance?
faq.a: No. Care plans are always optional, and your website works without one.

Yes. After full payment, I hand over the agreed website materials and access, and ownership of the agreed custom work transfers to you, subject to third-party licenses (such as fonts, plugins or stock images).

No. Domain, hosting and any third-party services are paid by you directly to the providers, and I go through these costs with you before launch. Connecting your domain and publishing the site is part of my work.

faq.q: Can I cancel a care plan anytime?
faq.a: Yes. Both care plans are month-to-month, with no long-term contract, and you keep your website.

faq.q: Do I need Business or Advanced?
faq.a: It depends on what your website needs to do. A Business Website starts at $1,800 and covers up to five pages. An Advanced Custom Website starts at $3,500 and is for technically complex projects, such as a CMS, custom forms, integrations or functionality tailored to your business; its pages and features are tailored to your project and confirmed in your proposal. Either way, I agree the scope and final price with you before work begins.

faq.q: What if I need more pages or features?
faq.a: For a new website, extra pages or features are discussed and quoted separately, and the final price is agreed before work begins. For a website I've already built, that's Additional Development: a one-time project, quoted individually. Nothing extra is billed without your approval.

faq.q: Can you update or maintain a website someone else built?
faq.a: Not at the moment. I only update, maintain or redesign websites I've built. If your current website was made by another developer or agency, I can build you a new website.

faq.q: How is my website tested, and what if something breaks after launch?
faq.a: Every website package includes testing before launch and a short report describing what was checked. For an Advanced Custom Website, the checks depend on the features and scope we agree on. Testing can't guarantee a website will be completely error-free. For 30 days after launch, you can report defects in my work within the agreed project scope, and I'll correct them. New requests, features and content changes are separate work and are quoted individually.

faq.q: Can I update the website myself?
faq.a: It depends on whether your website has a CMS (an editor for text and images). A CMS isn't part of the One-Page or Business starting price, but it can be discussed and quoted; on an Advanced Custom Website it can be one of the features confirmed in your proposal. Without a CMS, changes are made in the code: you can request a one-off change, quoted individually, or choose Business Care, which includes up to 60 minutes of small content updates a month.

faq.q: Are AI assistants included in the website packages?
faq.a: No. An AI assistant isn't part of any website's starting price. It can be added as a separately quoted project, and we can discuss it together with your website. AI usage and other third-party costs are shown in advance and paid separately.

faq.q: Will I know about recurring costs before launch?
faq.a: Yes. Domain, hosting, other third-party services and any AI usage costs are disclosed before launch.
The deposit and balance arrangement is agreed with you before work begins.
